Junior Data Analyst, remote within India. You will clean data, write SQL queries, build dashboards in Tableau or Power BI, and present findings to business teams. Requirements: a degree in statistics, maths, engineering or similar; working knowledge of Python, pandas, SQL and Excel; clear writing and a habit of documenting your work. Experience with A/B testing, statistics and data visualization is a plus. Internships and academic projects count. You will learn from senior analysts, join weekly reviews, and grow into owning a reporting area. We care about accuracy, curiosity and clear communication with people who are not technical.
